agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario shows actuated EW green held continuously from ~570s to 767s (>190s) while NS queues grow, exceeding max_green_seconds=47 and starving NS beyond 200s. Root cause: detector_fail on W (the green direction) is treated as persistent demand, preventing gap-out, and the max_green / long-wait recall fails to force termination while that detector is failed. Removing only the detector_fail restores normal cycling and eliminates the violation, proving the failed-detector handling disables the forced max-green termination.
